triggers.description: A candidate specification or objective needs governance followed by one implementation-ready execution policy.
The user explicitly authorizes bypassing full specification governance for already accepted decision-complete intent.
An existing plan identity must be revised for changed source, evidence, architecture, repository state, or proof assumptions.
Specification or policy depends on a consequential architecture, representation, owner, composition law, or abstraction factorization.

routes.description: Adopt, repair, or reconstruct the candidate specification before policy synthesis.
Emit one source-bound architecture-aware EPG after exhaustive refinement and passive Ledger validation.
Revise the existing plan identity from the earliest affected specification or policy phase.
Return an unresolved material user judgment that inspected artifacts cannot answer.
Block because source authority, identity, evidence, architecture, proof, or structural validation is unavailable or contradictory.

required_artifacts: one final EPG-v1 when synthesis succeeds
self-contained execution plan when human or both output is selected
success_signals: bare $plan followed by candidate text selects spec-to-plan
$plan direct alone bypasses full specification governance
revision preserves the existing plan_id
bare and implicit planning select the reader-first human output view
explicit EPG JSON is fully indented and exact-byte validated
failure_signals: direct mode inferred from apparent candidate completeness
caller must separately invoke another planning skill
distinct objectives merged under one plan identity
default output is dominated by inline EPG JSON
clauses.rationale: The public mode expresses intent; specification operation, rigor, authority, terminal result, and output view remain separate dimensions.

required_artifacts: execution-complete human projection when human or both output is selected
success_signals: a fresh implementation session can execute from the proposed_plan block and target repository alone
every material judgment is decided or bound to an exact observation-conditioned branch
compression removes representation noise without removing implementation semantics
failure_signals: execution requires the original candidate text, prior conversation, private synthesis, or omitted EPG body
an action lacks its dependency, target, intended change, proof, or material failure route
a material open or deferred item remains inside the claimed done-state
clauses.rationale: The ordinary human view is the execution source; machine canonicality cannot justify a lossy public plan.

success_signals: candidate disposition is adopt, repair, reconstruct, or block
one strongest invariant challenge completed
specification fresh eyes is clean
governed specification lowers directly into policy
failure_signals: candidate treated as trusted authority
source-fixed decision invented
hidden consequential architecture
governance receipt or handoff packet introduced
clauses.rationale: A strong externally generated specification is valuable candidate evidence, not proof of current repository fit or authority.

success_signals: not_required plans contain no fabricated seams
explicit seams are dispositioned
no dominated retained factor
no action realizes a foreign or retired factor
failure_signals: architecture exists only in prose
file-shaped factors
duplicated or reconstructed truth
clauses.rationale: Architecture and abstraction are state over which specification and policy jointly converge.

required_artifacts: structural validation bound to exact bytes
success_signals: architecture-policy candidate reaches a zero-material-delta sweep
private radical candidate is dispositioned
exact emitted EPG is structurally valid under Plan's passive definition
failure_signals: structural validation described as semantic authority
policy optimized inside an unchallenged invalid specification
runtime state or execution authority authored by Plan
clauses.rationale: Planning quality depends on continuous specification-to-policy refinement, not schema presence or an ownership-transfer protocol.

success_signals: same plan_id with incremented revision
earliest affected specification or policy phase rerun
stale actions retired or revised
failure_signals: new plan identity for unchanged objective
existing plan selected only because it is recent
revision bypasses source drift
clauses.rationale: Revision preserves objective identity while recompiling every affected semantic and execution consequence.

success_signals: detailed specification or planning intent may activate implicitly
direct implementation, debugging, review, factual explanation, and divergent options remain with their owners
failure_signals: Plan seizes mixed plan-and-implement work and discards execution
ordinary explanation becomes an EPG
direct mode activates without its explicit literal
clauses.rationale: Implicit availability reduces caller skill-selection burden without widening Plan into a universal turn owner.

instrumentation.rationale: The execution-complete human projection and canonical EPG expose the consequential result; passive Ledger validation is structural evidence only.
